# Southborough Airport Taxis

> Southborough Airport Taxis (trading as C Line Cars) is a licensed private hire operator based in Southborough, Tunbridge Wells, Kent (TN4), England. It provides fixed-price airport and seaport taxi transfers 24 hours a day from 12 towns in West Kent and East/West Sussex. Phone and WhatsApp: 07808 065494 (+447808065494). Email: clinetaxi@gmail.com.

Key facts:
- Fares are fixed when booked; no charge for flight delays; flight tracking and meet & greet inside the terminal for arrivals; first 60 minutes of waiting after landing free.
- Drivers are licensed by Tunbridge Wells Borough Council and DBS-checked.
- Vehicles: saloon (1–4 passengers), estate/MPV (5–6), minibus (7–8), executive saloon (1–4).
- Towns covered: Southborough, Tunbridge Wells, Tonbridge, Sevenoaks, Paddock Wood, Maidstone, Crowborough, Edenbridge, East Grinstead, Westerham, Hartfield, Hawkhurst.
- Saloon fares from Southborough: Gatwick £72, Heathrow £95, London City £90, Stansted £130, Luton £148, Folkestone £65, Dover £78, Tilbury £100, Southampton £120, Harwich £175.
- Saloon fares from Tunbridge Wells: Gatwick £78, Heathrow £101, London City £96, Stansted £136, Luton £154, Folkestone £71, Dover £84, Tilbury £106, Southampton £126, Harwich £181.
- Gatwick is the closest airport to Southborough and Tunbridge Wells (about 25 miles, 40–55 mins).
